name: Dialog Engine
author: ct
description: Engine dialog subsystem: DialogBox/DialogCanvas/AnswerBox UI, the dialog queue runtime with the full DSL action set, the .scenario parser with command strategies, the executable event chains and the /root/DialogRunner for interactive dialogs. Replaces the former Core/UI/Dialog, Core/UI/Executable and Core/Scenarios implementations — SceneManager and SaveService keep driving chains and events through the core contracts (IDialogBox, IExecutableEvent, IExecutableEventChain, IScenarioEventFactory).
